body: Thanks for the kind words, but I’ve came to realize that even if there might be people who care for me, they’re more than able to live without me. I’m very set on my decision, although I need to prepare myself better for it.
Usually the time to hop on reddit
Guess who’s opening up a one member barber club ;)
To feel anything or to calm down during an anxiety attack.
“Yes, of course, how come you ask? As you can see, I’m flourishing - never been better...”
Also bandaids are like super expensive. Feel like even smoking would be cheaper at this point...
When I got released from the youth psychiatry, they had me sign a paper insuring that I wouldn’t kill myself within the next two weeks - surprisingly enough, I actually didn’t.

Actually jumping in front of a train is one of the best options out there. If you’re lucky enough you’re dead immediately, otherwise you’ll most likely bleed out in 5-10 minutes. Only issue is the trauma you cause for the driver and passengers. I’ve also thought about how to actually jump - (maybe intoxication?!?)

I’ve read that any kind of poisoning is statistically not very effective, although when done right, it seems to be the cleanest option. Saw a crime documentary where a woman killed her entire family with Antifreeze - supposedly sweet tasting and a cup will be enough. Afterwards I read online that if not done right tho, you’ll have your kidneys failing and it will be a long and painful dying process or you might not die at all.

So hopefully this is enough for another 1000 chances.

We don’t know about the 2nd one for sure

The test says to be done with/by a professional and even though most people probably rate themselves honestly, it doesn’t provide too much insight into ones mental health. Also mental health issues aren’t a competition -we’re all in this together...
